Biology.text: Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
What is the basic unit of life?
Biology.explanation: Cells are the basic structural and functional units of life.

Biology.text: Where does photosynthesis mainly occur in plant cells?
Biology.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and photosynthetic machinery.

Biology.text: What is the name of the process by which cells divide to produce two genetically identical daughter cells?
Biology.explanation: Mitosis produces two genetically identical daughter cells.

General Knowledge.text: How many days are in a standard non-leap year?
Which language is primarily spoken in Brazil?
What is the largest ocean on Earth?
General Knowledge.explanation: The Pacific is the largest ocean.

General Knowledge.text: What is the only mammal capable of true sustained flight?
General Knowledge.explanation: Bats are the only mammals capable of powered flight.

History.text: The ancient pyramids of Giza are in which country?
The Renaissance began in which present-day country?
History.explanation: The Renaissance began in Italian city-states.

Which document, adopted in 1215, limited the power of the English king?
History.explanation: King John sealed Magna Carta in 1215.

History.text: Which West African empire was famously ruled by Mansa Musa in the 14th century?
History.explanation: Mansa Musa ruled the Mali Empire.

Geography.text: Which country has the most time zones when overseas territories are included?
Geography.explanation: France's overseas territories give it the most time zones.

Politics & Government.text: In a democracy, citizens commonly choose leaders through:
Politics & Government.explanation: Elections are a common democratic mechanism.

Politics & Government.text: How many branches are in the U.S. federal government?
Politics & Government.explanation: The branches are legislative, executive, and judicial.

Politics & Government.text: What is the main role of a constitution?
Politics & Government.explanation: A constitution establishes governing framework and limits.

Politics & Government.text: Which chamber of the U.S. Congress has 100 members, two from each state?
What term describes dividing governmental power between national and regional governments?
Politics & Government.explanation: Federalism shares authority between levels of government.

Music.text: How many strings does a standard violin have?
Music.explanation: A standard violin has four strings.

Music.text: Which family does the trumpet belong to?
Music.explanation: The trumpet is a brass instrument.

Music.text: How many semitones are in an octave in standard Western equal temperament?
Which composer wrote the Ninth Symphony known for its 'Ode to Joy' finale?
Music.explanation: Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 includes the famous choral finale.

Music.explanation: A minor shares the same key signature as C major.

Art.text: Which primary color is made by mixing blue and yellow paint?
Art.explanation: Blue and yellow pigment make green.

Art.explanation: Fresco is painted onto fresh, wet plaster.

In linear perspective, parallel lines appear to meet at what point?
Art.explanation: Perspective lines converge at a vanishing point.

Technology.explanation: HTTPS encrypts HTTP traffic using TLS.

Technology.explanation: The search interval is halved each step.

Literature.explanation: A traditional sonnet has fourteen lines.

Literature.explanation: Both epic poems are traditionally attributed to Homer.

Literature.explanation: An allusion is an indirect reference.

Sports.explanation: Five players per team play on court.

Space & Astronomy.text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
Space & Astronomy.explanation: Iron-rich dust gives Mars its reddish appearance.

Space & Astronomy.text: What is the closest star to Earth?
Space & Astronomy.explanation: The Sun is Earth's nearest star.

Space & Astronomy.text: What galaxy contains our Solar System?
Space & Astronomy.explanation: Our Solar System is in the Milky Way.

Space & Astronomy.text: What is the boundary around a black hole beyond which light cannot escape called?
Space & Astronomy.explanation: The event horizon marks the point of no return.

Space & Astronomy.text: What is the name of the first directly imaged interstellar object discovered passing through our Solar System in 2017?
Space & Astronomy.explanation: ʻOumuamua was discovered in 2017 on an interstellar trajectory.

Business & Economics.text: What is the money paid for work usually called?
Business & Economics.explanation: A wage is compensation for labor.

Business & Economics.explanation: Higher demand generally raises equilibrium price.

Business & Economics.text: In finance, what does diversification primarily aim to reduce?
Business & Economics.explanation: Spreading investments can reduce exposure to any single asset or risk.
